rationale: Settings tightened to reflect data constraints: reference quantile raised to 0.85 to focus on high-yield stress scenarios given the limited sample size (n=602); stress threshold increased to 1.2 to filter out mild anomalies; water_proxy shift capped at 0.3 to prevent unrealistic counterfactuals since only water is modifiable; actionable features limited to 3 (temperature_hazard, water_proxy, crop_state_indicator) as fertilizer/irrigation/cultivar data are absent; top stresses reduced to 5 to prioritize the most significant drivers (temperature, water, radiation, crop state, fixed context) without inventing missing treatment variables.
